original_test_intent: Verify the approved BMC account password can be changed and saved through its WebUI Profile setting, with controlled proof that the new credential works and the old one no longer does.
original_method: An authorized operator selects the exact account in a dedicated Web session, enters a policy-compliant secret through protected handling, saves once, verifies new and old access through independent sessions, updates approved consumers/escrow and retains only non-secret audit evidence.
manual_activity: An authorized owner/operator must approve and perform the credential mutation through the exact WebUI account with independent recovery; the agent may validate only protected non-secret metadata and session outcomes.
required_inputs: Exact BMC/SUT, account ID/role and whether the displayed root account is authoritative
Password complexity/history/length/expiry/lockout policy and allowed attempt budget
Secret-manager generation, escrow, consumer rotation and evidence references
Independent recovery account/session or console and tested rollback credential
Decision to retain new password or restore baseline after validation
Dedicated Web session, audit-log path and non-secret evidence schema
safety_requirements: Require explicit owner approval for the exact account and one controlled change
Never print, echo, screenshot, export or place old/new passwords in command arguments
Keep an independently verified recovery path open before saving
Do not import/export/overwrite a profile or alter any unrelated account/channel setting
Use one bounded new-login and one bounded old-credential rejection check under lockout policy
Stop immediately on wrong account, policy error, lockout risk, access loss or unexpected scope change
agent_execution_scope: Verify non-secret target/account/policy/approval and recovery readiness
Collect protected non-secret pre/post account/channel/audit metadata
Observe only outcome flags for operator Web change and independent login tests
Confirm authorized consumer/escrow references without revealing values
Make no password entry, profile overwrite, automatic retry or PASS/FAIL verdict
engineer_actions: Approve exact account, password policy, secret escrow, recovery and retention/rollback
Perform/supervise WebUI password save and bounded access verification
Review scope/access/audit evidence and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Read-only `channel getaccess`/`user list` can corroborate account metadata but neither performs nor proves the source's password change. Profile file save/restore is out of scope and command-line passwords are prohibited.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use no CLI password mutation. Operator performs the single WebUI change through secret-manager integration; automation collects non-secret metadata and protected login success/rejection results through approved interfaces.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Profile setting path, root-label source, change/save action, password change acceptance and 5/5-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: CRITICAL OWNER-GATED BMC PASSWORD ROTATION VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Preflight recovery and lockout budget, perform one exact-account WebUI rotation with a generated escrowed secret, validate new/old access in separate sessions, rotate authorized consumers and record only redacted audit references.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Restores the exact password scope and adds the controls needed to avoid lockout/secret leakage; excludes profile import/export.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: User/channel listings can show an account exists but cannot prove the password changed, new authentication works or old authentication is revoked.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Testing old-credential rejection consumes a failed-login attempt and may trigger lockout; the owner must define the attempt budget and whether the new credential remains active.

project_override_considerations: Service-account or shared-root exceptions must name every authorized consumer and rotation owner; no override may permit plaintext secrets or unapproved profile overwrite.
expected_evidence: Verified BMC/SUT/account/role, approval, policy and recovery readiness
Secret-manager/escrow reference and WebUI change timestamp with no values
Bounded independent new-login success and old-login rejection outcomes
Non-secret pre/post account/channel/audit scope and consumer rotation/rollback status
No secret exposure/profile overwrite/auto-retry plus engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria clearly define password change under Profile setting. DeepSeek's broader profile export/import narrative is an incorrect implementation expansion, not a contradiction within the source.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Secure secrets, recovery and approval are required package/user inputs. The controlled change is executable with an authorized operator, so static review is complete rather than globally blocked.

review_improvement: Restores the precise credential-change coverage, removes unauthorized profile-file scope and adds lockout-safe verification, recovery and zero-secret evidence handling.
independent_technical_reasoning: A password-change test is incomplete if it only proves a save action or new-login success: caching/session continuity could mask failure, and retaining the old credential would defeat rotation. Conversely, testing rejection repeatedly can lock out the only administrator. The minimum safe proof is one owner-budgeted independent new login plus one old-credential rejection with recovery already established and no credential bytes in evidence.
